apiContracts: Library, history and following views localize their static interface text using a 14-locale dictionary.
Library uses the existing authenticated /api/library, /api/history, /api/bookmarks and /api/follows APIs.
Removing a bookmarked chapter uses the existing owner-scoped DELETE /api/bookmark operation; no client-supplied owner identity.
Continue Reading displays the saved within-chapter progress percentage.
Library ratings use the canonical whole-number ten-point rating formatter; no legacy five-point conversion or fabricated decimal score.
dataEntities: Existing bookmarks, history, library and follows entities only.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuses existing library, history, bookmarks and follows records; no new persistent entity.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: No API or schema change. Existing saved stories, bookmarks and reading positions remain intact.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Code-only rollback; no data repair required.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Library, following and history pages mark translatable leaf labels and apply the selected locale; removal actions re-localize updated empty states.

privacySecurity.authorization: Existing library/history/follow APIs remain authenticated; bookmark deletion reuses the already-reviewed session-owner-scoped DELETE endpoint.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: No owner identifier is accepted from the client; existing Worker APIs bind user_id to session u.id.
privacySecurity.csrf: Existing same-origin mutation policy remains in force for bookmark deletion.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Existing rights-eligible public story projection and private account scoping remain unchanged.

integration: Fourteen locale dictionary completeness; library/history/following rendering; explicit bookmark removal; progress display; source/served bundle parity.
isolation: Bookmark removal continues to use the session-owner-scoped Worker DELETE endpoint.

stagingSteps: Verify the 14 locale labels on Library, History and Following pages.
Verify removal of one bookmark leaves other bookmarks visible and removing the last bookmark displays the empty state.
Verify whole-number ten-point ratings and reading progress display.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the library localization dictionary, helper and page integration together.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: No route added; existing library/history/following routes and bookmark DELETE are reused.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Reader and experience shell own the UI; platform quality owns the regression test; architecture contract updated.

changeSummary: Adds 14-language Library/History/Following localization, reading-progress visibility and bookmark removal controls while preserving the canonical ten-point rating model.
acceptanceCriteria: All 14 locale dictionaries contain all 25 required Library/History strings.
Library, History and Following pages apply the selected language.
Users can remove a saved bookmark without affecting other bookmark rows.
Removing the last bookmark displays the empty state.
Ratings continue using the canonical ten-point formatter.
No migration or production data mutation.
